**Verdict.** Accepted for pinned-vLLM reference-oracle artifact completeness. The sample count is one, cross-run variance is unknown, and this result makes no Rocket accuracy claim.

**Next.**

- Run Rocket whole-engine generation on the same 87 input tokens and eight decision positions.
- Compare every Rocket boundary, logit vector, sampled token, and prior-token link against this oracle.

**Reopen if.**

- Rebuild the oracle when upstream vLLM changes Qwen3 response parsing or the forward/logits lifecycle, or when NVIDIA publishes a different checkpoint revision or container image.
